processing: ORP polygons dissolved from the reconciled municipal mesh using official RÚIAN municipality → POU → ORP links. Prague administrative districts dissolved from their officially assigned boroughs. Military areas remain outside ORP service areas. The local mesh is simplified together at two metres; district and region outlines are dissolved from it. Complete national arcs are anchored at verified survey tripoints; original surveys and independent junction evidence are retained.
